promptSet.base: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one standalone painted inventory/UI icon for the gothic survival game Grave Accord. Carefully hand-painted semi-realistic item illustration, grounded practical object, worn materials, matte aged brass, restrained warm highlights from the upper left, thin dark silhouette contour and broad readable forms. Slight three-quarter top-down view. Center the complete object, filling about 84 percent of a square canvas with generous clear separation at the edges. True transparent background. It must read clearly at 32 to 48 pixels. No scenery, characters, text, letters, numbers, decorative frame, glow, particles or dramatic effects.

specs.subject: Primary subject: a compact closed dark-brown leather field equipment case, a sturdy horizontal rectangular shape with a small carry handle, two simple buckle straps, aged brass corner reinforcements and a clear central latch. A useful old equipment case with a clean unmistakable silhouette. No weapons protruding and no extra loose objects.

Primary subject: three thick worn brass-gold coins: two in a low stack and one leaning against them. Plain incised concentric rings and nicked rims, no skulls, lettering or currency symbols. A simple recognizable money icon. Keep the coins warm pale gold and separated clearly.

Primary subject: a small open field manual with dark forest-green leather covers, aged ivory pages and a single muted green cloth bookmark. Minimal clean diagrams of a few connected ink dots on one page, without text or letters. A recognizable learning and skill-points icon, with clearly readable open-book silhouette.
